title: One by One
body: Each week follows four steps. Up next shows where you are, and the (i) on any step says what to do there.

title: Start with the report
body: Bring your lists up to date with the Covenant Path Report in Member Tools. Names with a red bar are suggested focus names.

title: Counsel together
body: Plan for upcoming events, and counsel together about steps people on the Covenant Path Report took this week.

title: Choose your focus names
body: Use the Covenant Path Report and the Part-Member Families report to help identify focus names. Names with a red bar are suggested.

title: A brief, focused huddle
body: Report back on last week, note who came to sacrament meeting, and plan for upcoming opportunities to invite.

title: One assignment for each name
body: Decide what we’ll do this week to help each focus name, who will do it and when, and text them the assignment. Never add confidential information to this huddle report.

title: Update the report
body: Huddle lists only what changed. Update those names in the Covenant Path Report.

title: Send the huddle report
body: Send it to the bishop-approved list, the stake presidency and the full-time missionaries, and include yourself. Only share via email or text message. Do not share through any other app.

title: Help each person take their next step
body: Ward council members and their organizations, along with the huddle, help each person take their next step. Then let the ward mission leader know so he can mark it on the Covenant Path Report. Tap Assignments to follow up during the week.

title: One by one
body: We are joyfully gathering Israel one by one in Christ. Every name here is someone the Lord knows and loves. Thank you for helping each one take their next step on the covenant path.
